items.description:
Foschini at Liberty Promenade in Mitchells Plain is a women's fashion retailer offering clothing, footwear, accessories and beauty products, confirmed through the centre's own store directory. Part of the long-running Foschini Group chain found in shopping centres across the country, the store builds its range around contemporary, trend-driven fashion designed to suit different styles, ages and occasions.

It serves women and fashion-conscious shoppers looking for everyday clothing, seasonal fashion pieces, footwear, accessories and beauty products, with new stock brought in through the seasons to track changing trends. The store trades from Liberty Promenade in Mitchells Plain, and suits shoppers who want clothing, footwear and beauty essentials covered in one visit to the centre.

JEM Hair and Beauty Studio in Strandfontein is a full-service hair and beauty salon, with a menu running from hair cuts, colour, highlights and balayage through to hair treatments, extensions and keratin-related services. Alongside the hair side of the business, the salon offers facials, waxing, lash extensions and a full nail menu covering gel, acrylic, polygel and nail art.

The salon runs a loyalty and rewards programme for regular clients, offers free Wi-Fi on site and gives pensioner discounts, with staff trained across both the hair and beauty sides of the business. It serves general salon and beauty clients, including customers wanting hair styling and colouring, nail care and skincare treatments, from its premises on the corner of Dennegeur Avenue and Admiral's Hill Drive in Strandfontein.

items.description:
KFC at Maynard Mall in Wynberg is a fast-food restaurant specialising in chicken meals, burgers and other familiar KFC menu items, serving American-style fast food. The branch takes orders for both collection and delivery, and also allows customers to schedule an order ahead for a later collection or delivery time.

It serves customers looking for a convenient fast-food meal, including shoppers eating in at the mall and customers ordering for collection or delivery across Wynberg and the surrounding suburbs. The restaurant trades from Shop 13 in Maynard Mall on Main Road, Wynberg, and suits anyone wanting a quick, familiar meal with the flexibility of eating in, collecting or having it delivered.

items.description:
Kommetjie Estate Agency is a property agency based in Kommetjie, offering property sales and related real-estate services to the local community. By its own account the agency has been trading in Kommetjie for more than 35 years, making it one of the area's earliest estate agencies, starting out as one of only two agents working the village.

It serves home buyers, sellers, property owners and other clients involved in residential property transactions in Kommetjie and the surrounding area, drawing on decades of local experience. The agency is based at the Swan Lodge Building on Main Street in Kommetjie, and suits anyone looking to buy, sell or get local advice on property in the area.

Luitingh & Associates is a Cape Town law firm with more than 40 years of experience, supporting individuals, families and businesses through legal challenges. The Rondebosch office is at Athos Chambers, on the corner of Campground Road and Austwick Avenue, and the firm describes itself as a full-service practice.

Its core practice areas include business setup and structuring, mergers and acquisitions, and contract and compliance work, alongside litigation and advisory matters. The firm says each case is handled on its own terms rather than from templates, and it promises clear communication throughout.

The firm suits anyone who needs legal support in Cape Town, whether for a personal matter or for a business that needs help with setup, contracts or a deal.

items.description:
Northern Aquatics in Bothasig is an aquarium and pet retailer specialising in aquarium products and aquatic livestock. Its range covers freshwater, cichlid, discus and marine aquarium supplies, including water conditioners, filtration products, buffers and aquarium medications from established aquatics brands, alongside a variety of live aquatic species and ready-built aquarium stands.

It serves aquarium and pet owners, particularly customers maintaining freshwater, cichlid, discus and marine tanks who need reliable water-treatment and filtration products alongside livestock and setup equipment, from newcomers setting up a first tank to experienced keepers maintaining established systems. The shop trades from Shop 1 in the Sulnisa Centre on Vryburger Avenue in Bothasig, and suits hobbyists after a specialist range rather than a general pet-shop selection.

Ocean View House is a four-star boutique guest house in Bakoven, Cape Town, offering a bed and breakfast stay in a stylish, sophisticated setting. The property sits between the Twelve Apostles and overlooks the Atlantic Ocean, with 360-degree mountain and ocean views.

The guest house has 28 rooms and units and a swimming pool, and its staff speak German. The listing describes the setting as a serene oasis of quiet sophistication, where guests can enjoy magnificent views of the mountains and the ocean from the property.

It suits travellers who want a calm, luxurious base on the Atlantic seaboard, between the Twelve Apostles and the ocean.

OK Furniture in Gugulethu Shopping Centre sells furniture, home theatre systems and appliances from local and imported brands, with cash or terms available. Its range includes bedroom suites, lounge suites, base sets, TVs and DVD players.

The business says it offers one of the broadest wall-to-wall carpet services in the country, with a free, obligation-free quotation for customers. It describes its aim as giving customers exactly what they want, when they want it, at prices they deserve.

The store is at Shop 1 and 2 in the Gugulethu Shopping Centre in Guguletu, Cape Town, and suits shoppers who want to furnish a home on cash or terms close to where they live.

items.description:
PEP Cell at Gugulethu Square is the mobile-phone-focused retail format of the PEP chain, selling cellular handsets and phone accessories rather than the general merchandise carried in a standard PEP store. Its catalogue is built around current cellular deals and promotions, refreshed regularly as new handsets and offers come in.

It serves local mobile-phone users and shoppers in Gugulethu looking for cellphones and accessories at everyday prices, as an alternative to the general PEP Stores branch at the same centre. PEP Cell trades from Shop 36 in Gugulethu Square, and suits anyone whose shopping trip is specifically about a phone or a phone accessory.

PEP Stores at Gugulethu Square is the general retail branch of the PEP chain, carrying clothing and everyday merchandise rather than the cellular-only range sold next door at the centre's PEP Cell branch. The store runs on PEP's usual catalogue-driven promotions, refreshed through the year.

It serves local Gugulethu shoppers after value-oriented everyday retail products, from clothing to household basics, and trades from Shop 31 in Gugulethu Square. The branch is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 5pm and Sundays from 9am to 2pm, making it accessible for a weekday or weekend shop in the area.

Pick n Pay Hyper in Ottery is a large-format supermarket trading from the Ottery Hyper Shopping Centre on New Ottery Road, carrying a full grocery range alongside household and general merchandise under one roof. As a hypermarket-format store, it is built for a full weekly shop rather than a quick top-up.

It serves households and shoppers in Ottery and the surrounding southern Cape Town suburbs looking for groceries and everyday essentials, with the store open Monday to Thursday from 9am to 6pm, Fridays until 9pm, Saturdays from 8am to 6pm and Sundays from 9am to 5pm. It suits shoppers who want a wide range in one stop within the Ottery Hyper centre.

items.description:
Silver Spoon Indian Restaurant in Tokai Village Centre specialises in North Indian cuisine, with a menu built around curries and char-grilled chicken and lamb prepared in tandoori ovens. The restaurant caters for both vegetarian and non-vegetarian diners, with dishes available for sit-down dining or for collection.

It serves diners looking for Indian cuisine, particularly customers wanting North Indian curries and tandoori-grilled dishes, open daily from late morning through to the evening for both lunch and dinner. The restaurant has built up a strong following of reviewers and trades from Suite 101 in the Tokai Village Centre in Tokai, making it a good choice for a relaxed Indian meal in the southern suburbs.

items.description:
Super Plants Garden Centre in Tokai opened its doors on 16 September 1999 and is a family owned and managed business. It stocks a wide range of plants suited to the varied growing conditions across the Western Cape, along with gardening accessories and organic products.

The centre gives its indoor plant selection as a particular strength, and says sourcing and stocking unusual plants is its speciality. The business calls itself award-winning, and describes its staff as well trained and friendly.

The business also uses captured water from air-conditioning units to irrigate about 20 percent of its plants. The centre is open seven days a week at 1 Tokai-on-Main on Main Road, and suits anyone looking for a wide choice of plants, indoor plants and gardening supplies in Tokai.

Tony's Liquors is a bottle store in Richwood, Milnerton, selling alcoholic beverages including beer, spirits, wine and liqueurs, along with ice for a fridge or cooler box. The business trades under the Tony's Liquors name at its Richwood address, a name that is consistent across the area's business and licensing records.

It serves adult customers in Richwood and the surrounding northern Cape Town suburbs who are shopping for liquor and related products, whether for a quick top-up or a full stock-up before a weekend. The store is based in the La Piazza Complex at 39 Nederberg Drive in Richwood, and suits residents looking for a convenient neighbourhood bottle store.

Tosca Salon Durbanville is a hair salon forming part of a wider Western Cape salon group, and operates as a Wella Professionals salon with colour specialists offering premium colour services. Its range of services covers balayage, blow-drying, children's haircuts, hair colouring and highlights, together with hair extensions, weaves, keratin treatments, perms and permanent hair straightening.

Backed by the Wella Professionals brand and its wider salon group, the team is set up for colour work as well as everyday cuts and treatments, serving adults and children looking for professional hair styling, colouring and treatment services under one roof.

The salon trades from Shop 8 in the Midville (Checkers) Centre, on the corner of Wellington and Oxford Street in Durbanville, and suits anyone wanting an established, colour-focused salon that caters for the whole family.

Vitacare Pharmacy is a pharmaceutical and healthcare provider operating as part of the Vitacare pharmacy group, which describes its approach as pharmaceutical care that puts patients first. The pharmacy offers prescription medicines, pharmacy services and general healthcare products from its Lansdowne branch.

As part of a pharmacy group built around patient-first care, the branch closes over the Friday midday period for prayer time, a detail that reflects its place within the local community it serves. It serves Lansdowne and the surrounding Cape Town communities who rely on it for everyday prescription and healthcare needs.

The pharmacy trades from Office No. 650, Aslam Centre, Lansdowne Road, and is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 7pm, Saturdays from 9am to 1pm and Sundays from 10am to 1pm, making it a convenient stop for residents needing pharmacy care across most of the week.

Westgate Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy offering pharmacy-depot services, including prescription collection and dispensing, from its branch inside Westgate Mall. It is listed as a healthcare provider serving the Mitchells Plain area, with the mall's own directory placing the pharmacy among its health-related tenants.

As a depot-style pharmacy, it gives residents a place to drop off and collect prescriptions alongside everyday pharmacy needs, serving residents of Mitchells Plain and the surrounding communities who rely on nearby, accessible healthcare services.

The pharmacy trades from Shop 81, Westgate Mall, on the corner of Jakes Gerwel Drive and Morgenster Road, and suits shoppers looking to combine a pharmacy visit with the rest of their shopping at the mall.

items.description:
Be-Dazzle Hair Beauty and Slimming Salon is a hair, beauty and slimming salon that began with a single chair in 2002 and has since grown into multiple salons, including this branch in Strandfontein. That history of starting small and expanding over more than two decades is central to how the business describes itself today.

As part of a salon group built on that growth, the Strandfontein branch continues to offer hair, beauty and slimming-related salon services to the surrounding community, serving customers who want treatments across all three categories from one salon.

The salon trades from the Bangladesh Centre on Dennegeur Road in Strandfontein, and suits anyone looking for an established, long-running local salon for hair, beauty and slimming care.

Billboard Barbershop is a men's grooming and barbering business in Brooklyn, Cape Town, offering hair and shaving-related services, including head shaves, through an online booking system. The shop focuses on barbering rather than a broader salon menu, giving customers a dedicated space for cuts and shaves.

It serves customers across Brooklyn and the surrounding Cape Town suburbs looking for barbering and men's grooming services, and trades seven days a week, open from 8am to 8pm every day, making it easy to book around a working schedule.

The barbershop is located at 57 Koeberg Road, Brooklyn, Cape Town, 7489, and suits anyone wanting a dedicated, booking-friendly barbershop for haircuts and head shaves in the area.

Cape Space Interiors is a custom furniture and interior design business offering custom furniture and reupholstery alongside interior decorating and styling services. Its range extends to curtains and blinds, decorative products such as pillows, rugs and wallpapers, and both ready-made and customisable furniture pieces.

The business describes its furniture as handmade in Cape Town using materials sourced from around the world, alongside products made in South Africa, giving it a mix of local craftsmanship and international sourcing. It serves homeowners, decorators and designers looking for custom furniture, interior styling, upholstery and made-to-measure window treatments.

Cape Space Interiors is based at 7 Platinum Drive, Brooklyn, Cape Town, and suits anyone wanting a single business for furniture, upholstery and interior styling and decorating needs.

Checkers Hyper at Fairbridge Mall in Brackenfell reopened as a revamped supermarket in February 2021, with a stronger focus on fresh food and convenience, wider aisles and an improved layout. The revamp created 48 new jobs and brought the store's staff to 274.

The store's in-store departments include an artisanal bakery with breads, pastries and handmade pies, a deli with a charcuterie range, and stone-baked pizzas from an in-house open-flame oven. A sit-down sushi bar, a rodizio grill and an on-site food truck sit alongside a pet shop and a party shop, which were new to the chain's Western Cape stores at the time.

The store is in Fairbridge Mall on the corner of Old Paarl Road and Brackenfell Boulevard, and suits shoppers who want a full weekly shop and a meal or treats in one visit.

Craven Park Pharmacy is a family owned pharmacy on Connaught Road in Elsies River, Cape Town, which opened its doors in 1982. Its stated mission is to provide quality, efficient and cost-effective medicine to the community.

The pharmacy says it stocks as wide a range of medical products as it can and offers high-quality health services. Its medication management protocols guide customers to the medicines and advice they need, and staff aim to give each customer personal and professional attention.

It suits residents of Elsies River and the surrounding area who want a long-established local pharmacy that puts the wellbeing of its customers first.

items.description:
Durbanville Animal Hospital is a veterinary practice providing care for companion animals, with a strong focus on personalised treatment and clear communication with pet owners throughout a pet's care. The practice has been operating since 1986, and is currently marking 40 years of veterinary service in the area.

Its veterinary and nursing staff continually update their knowledge through ongoing professional development, keeping the practice's general medical and surgical capabilities current. After-hours emergencies are referred to Panorama Veterinary Clinic, giving pet owners a clear point of contact outside normal consulting hours.

The practice serves pet owners and their animals across Durbanville and the surrounding Cape Town communities from its premises at 4 De Villiers Drive, Valmary Park, and is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6:30pm, Saturdays from 9am to midday, and Sundays and public holidays from 10am to 11am.

Eastridge Clinic is a City of Cape Town primary healthcare clinic providing a range of public health services to the surrounding community. Its services include child health, family planning, HIV care and testing, STI assessment and treatment, TB assessment and treatment, and cancer screening.

As a City of Cape Town facility, the clinic forms part of the municipality's primary healthcare network, giving local residents access to essential preventative and treatment services without needing to travel to a larger hospital for routine care.

The clinic serves the surrounding Eastridge and Mitchells Plain community from its premises on 1st Avenue, Eastridge, Mitchells Plain, and is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm.

Edgars at Liberty Promenade is a department-style fashion, beauty and lifestyle retailer selling clothing, footwear, accessories, cosmetics, homeware and fragrances for men, women and children. The store combines well-known local and international brands with a value-driven approach to shopping.

As part of the wider Edgars retail chain, the Liberty Promenade branch offers a broad fashion, beauty and lifestyle range in one place, tailored to fashion-conscious shoppers looking for contemporary style across clothing and home categories alike.

The store trades from Shop 17, Liberty Promenade, in Mitchells Plain, and suits men, women, children and families shopping for fashion, beauty, footwear, accessories and home-related products in one visit.
